title: Release checks
lead: See which checks and reviews are confirmed for this running version, then open what still needs evidence.
unconfirmed: The current result is not confirmed
boundary: These recorded checks do not replace the required human and release approvals.
noCurrentReport: There is no confirmed, current set of reports for this running version. This does not prove that a connected service has stopped.
checkOnly: This reads the latest saved reports. It does not repeat a delivery, restart a service or release a version.
missingReportHelp: No report has been confirmed for this running version yet. Ask the person responsible for release to provide the matching report before treating this check as complete.
noDependentChecks: No further dependent check is listed in the current rules.

results.not_confirmed: No qualifying report is confirmed for this version.
results.rejected: A report was received but did not meet the required checks.

R00.title: Responsibilities and release rules
R00.help: The release scope, responsible people and required proof must be agreed.

R01.title: System checks and access
R01.help: Check the running application, database changes, staff and client access.

R02.title: Listing facts and publication
R02.help: People must review the source facts, availability, photos and publication decision.

R03.title: Search and inquiries
R03.help: Check approved search results and that an inquiry reaches its responsible person.

R04.title: Client work and next steps
R04.help: Check requirements, viewings, proposals, documents and continuity of the deal.

R05.title: Messages and privacy
R05.help: Check real delivery, access changes, consent and requests about personal information.

R06.title: Butler and manual fallback
R06.help: Check Butler with the connected model and keep the manual workflow available.

R07.title: Source pages and photos
R07.help: Check every old address, source record and photo, including the final transfer.

R08.title: Reliability and recovery
R08.help: Check load, security, alerts, protected backups and return to the previous version.

R09.title: Journeys, language and accessibility
R09.help: Review the complete journeys, approved content, languages and accessible controls.

R10.title: Release evidence and approval
R10.help: The exact version needs current proof and the required release approvals.

R11.title: Checks after public routing changes
R11.help: Check actual domains, secure connections, inquiries, access, photos and old addresses.

R12.title: Agency operating review
R12.help: A complete operating cycle and the responsible owner must confirm the handover.
